bullets.text: Near Periyapalayam, the public blocked the Chennai-Tirupati road for a five-hour power cut, and the office should monitor traffic disruptions.
In Pallikaranai marshland issue, PMK leader Anbumani urged Chief Minister Vijay to intervene, and the office must watch political developments.
In Thiruvallur district, Avadi police arrested a mother and her illicit partner for harassing a fifteen-year-old girl, and the office should track safety.
During Diwali, eighty-one people lost their eyesight across Thiruvallur due to firecrackers, and the office should review safety measures.
In Gummidipoondi, the fire department held a fire-free Diwali awareness event at KLK Government Boys school, and the office should support safety drives.
ELCOT and IIT Madras Pravartak Technologies signed an agreement for an AI data center, and the office should oversee project implementation.
LiveX and NVIDIA launched AI City at the Smart City Expo to bring physical AI to airports and hospitals, and the office should watch innovations.
